text:
```yaml
name: Release

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*.*.*'

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
        ruby-version: [3.2, 3.3]

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v2
    - name: Set up Ruby
      uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
      with:
        ruby-version: ${{ matrix.ruby-version }}
        bundler-cache: true
    - run: bundle install --jobs 4 --retry 3
    - run: bundle exec rake compile_rust
    - run: bundle exec rake test

  docker:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v2
    - name: Set up Ruby
      uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
      with:
        ruby-version: 3.2
        bundler-cache: true
    - run: bundle install --jobs 4 --retry 3
    - run: bundle exec rake compile_rust
    - run: docker build . -t ealdent/lda-ruby:${{ github.ref_name }}

  release:
    needs: [build, docker]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v2
    - name: Set up Ruby
      uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
      with:
        ruby-version: 3.2
        bundler-cache: true
    - run: bundle install --jobs 4 --retry 3
    - run: bundle exec rake compile_rust
    - run: bundle exec rake test
    - name: Create Release
      uses: release-plz/action@v0.5
      with:
        command: create
        token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
